answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer, switching or adding a source now introduces avoidable delivery and qualification risk before the primary contract expires. Negotiate an incumbent renewal using market benchmarks to target the mandated cost reduction while preserving continuity; the archived precedent for benchmark-driven price and payment concessions should be verified before committing. The 18% target may not be fully achievable without changing supply structure, so do not assume negotiations alone will close the entire gap.
